extracted.name: Bacon Chicken Livers
extracted.description: These bacon-wrapped chicken livers are great as an appetizer or main dish.
instruction_lines: Set an oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler.
Cut bacon slices in half; wrap bacon around each chicken liver, securing with toothpicks. Place on a broiler pan.

Broil in the preheated oven until bacon is cooked and crisp and livers are cooked through, 12 to 16 minutes, flipping halfway through. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
Serve with honey in a small dipping bowl.
